scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @tamaya/shared-types && npm run build -w @tamaya/db && npm run build -w @tamaya/media-resolver && npm run build -w @tamaya/core
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @tamaya/api && npm run build -w @tamaya/web && npm run build -w @tamaya/worker-resolve && npm run build -w @tamaya/worker-publish
scripts.stack:start: docker compose up -d --build && npm run native:start
scripts.stack:stop: npm run native:stop && docker compose down
scripts.stack:restart: npm run stack:stop && npm run stack:start
